description: Temporary Discord server template designed to organize and manage a complete event.

channels.name: 📢-announcements
channels.topic: Important announcements and updates about the event.

channels.name: 📅-schedule
channels.topic: Event schedule, activities, dates, and important times.

channels.name: 📋-information
channels.topic: General information, instructions, and details about the event.

channels.name: 📜-rules
channels.topic: Rules and guidelines that participants must follow during the event.

channels.name: 📝-registrations
channels.topic: Register and confirm participation in the event.

channels.name: ❓-questions
channels.topic: Ask questions and get help about the event.

channels.name: 💬-event-chat
channels.topic: Main chat for participants during the event.

channels.name: 💡-suggestions
channels.topic: Share ideas and suggestions related to the event.

channels.name: 🏆-results
channels.topic: Official event results, winners, and rankings.

channels.name: 🎁-prizes
channels.topic: Information about prizes, rewards, and winners.

channels.name: 📸-photos
channels.topic: Share photos and memorable moments from the event.

channels.name: 🎬-clips
channels.topic: Share clips and videos captured during the event.

channels.name: 💼-staff
channels.topic: Private staff coordination and event management.

channels.name: 📊-records
channels.topic: Internal event records, registrations, and results.
